title: Bun Cha with Rest-Meat
description: A lazy Sunday dish featuring rest-meat and mixed grain noodles. This roasted Vietnamese recipe is perfect for a low-glycemic-friendly meal.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and arrange the rest-meat on it.
Roast the rest-meat in the preheated oven for 20 minutes or until browned and cooked through.
While the rest-meat is roasting, cook the mixed grain rice stick noodles according to package instructions.
Chop the scallions and cucumber into thin slices.
Grate the fresh ginger using a microplane.
In a small bowl, whisk together the fish sauce, soy sauce, lime juice, sugar, and black pepper.
Once the rest-meat is done, slice it thinly against the grain.

To assemble the bun cha, place a portion of the noodles on a serving plate, add a few slices of the roasted rest-meat, and top with chopped scallions, cucumber slices, pickled carrots and daikon, and roasted peanuts.
